remarks: "ROLLING ON THE RIVER" A Stunning Wilton Retreat. Discover the beautiful remodeled 2,300 square foot home in enchanting Wilton, Connecticut. With Five spacious bedrooms and Three Full Baths, this elegant residence offers modern comfort while maintaining its timeless appeal. Step inside to find beautifully appointed interiors featuring high-end finishes and inviting layout perfect for entertaining. The expansive living spaces are bathed in Natural Light, enhancing the home's warm and welcoming atmosphere. Located in a sought after neighborhood, this home is just minutes from top-rated schools, scenic parks, vibrant shopping and dining options. Whether you're enjoying serene mornings by the river or hosting gatherings in the stylish living areas, this home is truly a place to unwind and embrace the beauty of Wilton living. Don't miss the opportunity to make Rolling on the River your next dream home- schedule a tour today! It boasts a serene riverfront setting making it a tranquil escape whether you are looking for a summer retreat or a year round haven. Let's make it your perfect getaway.
